summary: A lean check of the vfinal round's fix pass on the merged head: the hurt vignette's depth bounded and the bottom stroke floor; trim over walls in the clip solver, plinth ledges cut, KitPieces built on demand; the Kicker's brow and Ox's jaw zone; the closure test and the ledgers
read_first: docs/reviews/M6/findings-vfinal.json: the vfinal round's findings in full; the ids your lens verifies are named in your brief
docs/reviews/M6/fix-vfinal.md: what this pass was asked to do and 'Done when'
docs/milestones/M6-calls/VF2-FEEL.md, VF2-WORLD.md, VF2-ART.md: what each fixer says it did (claims to check, not facts)

lenses.brief: VERIFY, then hunt for what the pass broke. HURT: vfinal-world-01 and vfinal-code-01 (the medium: the bottom ink gain was stored in _edges, so the vignette's depth compounded on every heavy rear hit; a rear Bruiser smash's spikes reached about 53-63% of the screen height). VF2-FEEL keeps the stored edges at 1 or below, draws the extra bottom ink from a separate faded share, clamps the depth to hurt_overlay_depth_max, applies the gain to the struck share only, and replaces the 1.4x stroke gain with a floor on the bottom teeth's length (hurt_overlay_bottom_stroke_floor 0.2 of the height). Sources: captures_dir/hurt (the five hurt acts plus the new 'Look: player hurt rear run': three Bruiser smashes then three Thug pipe swings from behind) and captures_dir/passive_six (real hits; bot.log lines 'f<frame> Player: <move> <dmg> dmg <tier>'). BEFORE (3e7084e): /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-verify-final/hurt and passive_six. Check: the rear smash at hurt f2189 and the third rear pipe hit at f3751 no longer climb (the fixer says about 30% and 22% of the height, against 53% and 44%); the rear run holds the same depth hit after hit; a rear jab is still as plain at the moment it lands as a front jab (say how you measured: the share of a 15% bottom band changed at +2, +4 and +8 frames is one way); the bottom teeth clear the HP panel on a light rear hit; side and front hits no longer ink the bottom heavier than the other unstruck edges; looking down still lights the right edge; blocked hits light; no red. WORLD: vfinal-world-03 (the solver now ranks kit pieces, then trim by name (Jamb, Lintel, Post), then the bigger box; the walls yield to the jambs and lintels in street.tscn and the bars to the posts in roofs.tscn): tour f97 (a2 lintel edge), f201 (the warehouse jamb), f305 (the skyline door reveal and pilaster strip), f763 (the catwalk rail top) against 82bab12 (/Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-review/tour) and 3e7084e (captures/m6-verify-final/tour); the terrace rail tops (f659) are now plain olive everywhere where 82bab12 showed a dark slash on some: judge whether that reads worse. vfinal-code-04: MeshClip now also cuts a plinth board's top ledge and end caps inside a clipped rectangle: look at the wall feet of StartWall, EndWall, RightWall, Terrace/RightAWall0 and Catwalk/EndWall0 in the tour for a hole, an open board end or a line. KitPieces now build their mesh on demand: is every Dressing piece still there once and only once (no missing cornice, no doubled piece) at every tour pose and in drift; tangents are now carried: did any clipped face's shading change. The rooms (captures_dir/rooms against captures/m6-verify-final/rooms): no change. Flicker: held poses no worse than 3e7084e (python3 -I tools/ground_flicker.py on drift; per-mille changed pixels at held tour frames). The catwalk doorway's tan floor patch at f711 is the ground tile's paint (it goes grey with ground_sheet_off), left as it is; don't report it. The amplified difference against 3e7084e at every tour and rooms pose is the fastest way to find what changed. Each finding names the act, the frame or still, and the file or tunable that fixes it.

VERIFY vfinal-chars-01 and -02, then hunt for regressions. (1) The Kicker: a new region `brow` (slot 24 from slot 6, z 1.665-1.71) turns the pale strip under his brim into the brown shade, so his face should read brim, shade, mask as in assets/source/concepts/m6/kicker_c.jpg. Look at 1 m (captures_dir/r_kicker), 1.6 m turned 0, 90 and 150 degrees (dk), and about 2.5 m (lineup). Is the strip gone, does the brim stay thick, does a ragged dark line under the brim (the fixer kept it: the brim's underside, slot-23 faces at z 1.66-1.67) read as a bar or a scribble, and are the temple streaks (left on purpose) noticeable? The fixer did NOT record him bloodied: record the Kicker at 20% health at 1 m (the chars reviewer of the vfinal round did it with a probe act; their notes are in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m6-review-vfinal-chars/captures/review/pb3.out and the act edit they describe) and say whether the band bleeds and bruises as skin and looks right. (2) Ox: the hook at the mouth's left corner was slot-7 skin faces at z 1.53-1.57 under the face zone's floor; a new detail_bake zone `jaw` (slot 7, z 1.45-1.58, ink 0.05/0.15) removes it, and boss.glb is unchanged (only boss_detail.png). Look at 1 m (r_boss), 1.6 m turned (dox), 2.5 and 5 m (lineup or dox): no hook, the nose and mouth read (the fixer says the mouth line is a hairline at 1 m: is it too faint to read as a mouth?), and bloodied the jaw and face still bruise and bleed. (3) Regressions: the Thug, the Bruiser and the Punk at 1 m (r_thug, r_bruiser, r_punk) and the lineup must be identical to 3e7084e (captures/m6-verify-final/ has r_bruiser and lineup; for r_thug and r_punk compare against /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-feedback-verify/r_thug and, for the Punk, the played build /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-played/r_punk, allowing for the earlier waves' known Punk vest change). BEFORE for the Kicker and Ox: captures/m6-verify-final/r_kicker, dk, r_boss, dox, lineup (3e7084e). Out of scope (left on purpose): the Bruiser's small stair under the visor and his visor slit taking blood, Ox's mauve shadow-band patches, about 1% cloth texels on Ox's skin, the Punk's cap logo blot, the Bruiser's cuff ovals, Ox's sawtooth sleeve. Each finding names the character, the distance, the before and after stills, and the config key that fixes it.

Code, tests and ledgers over the pass's diff: git diff 3e7084e dc3ba85 (merges m6/vf2-feel, m6/vf2-world, m6/vf2-art). VERIFY: vfinal-code-01 (game/ui/hurt_overlay.gd: stored edges at 1 or below, the depth clamped, _alive_share at most 1, the gain on the struck share only; the new tests fail when the old logic is put back (the fixer says 14 assertions): check it in a scratch copy; every reader of edge_strength, drawn_strength and stroke_lengths_px; the new tunable hurt_overlay_bottom_stroke_floor in 'Hit feel > Hurt' with tuning/default.json matching `godot --headless -s tools/gen_default_preset.gd`, and the removed hurt_overlay_bottom_stroke_gain gone from every script, test and preset); vfinal-code-04 (MeshClip cuts standoff-board faces inside a clipped rectangle: can it over-cut, removing a face its partner does not cover, and leave a hole; the orphan scan's test can fail); vfinal-code-05 (InsetBlock.unresolved_yields() and the warning; the cross-section case not warned); vfinal-code-06 (steps() exempts named pair types and ACCEPTED_STEPS; can a new fence-look wall step in front of a wall unseen now); vfinal-code-07 (the epsilon documented; the scan reads Tuning.kit_coplanar_m; zero-area triangles dropped); vfinal-code-02 (the closure test: the path must be read inside a test body; try a file with an unused const, a path in a trailing comment, a path inside a helper never called, and a real roll-out file); vfinal-code-03 (the ASSETS rows for every binary changed since 3e7084e: kicker.glb, kicker_rest.glb, kicker_detail.png, boss_detail.png, and the rows the vfinal round named). Then the new code: tools/solve_insets.gd ranks trim by block name (Jamb, Lintel, Post): is that robust, is the solver still deterministic and current (rerun it on a scratch copy with yields_to stripped and compare with the scenes), and does apply_yields.py write only yields; KitPiece.ensure_mesh(): idempotent, no double build, no leaked mesh, and the clip now independent of sibling order (move a Dressing node before its Geometry in a scratch copy and run tests/test_m6_feedback_ground.gd); MeshClip now carries ARRAY_TANGENT: are the tangents' w signs kept and are tangents interpolated correctly at cut vertices; MeshClip.uncarried() and the push_error; the colliders unchanged (tests/test_m6_colliders.gd). The art configs: assets/source/characters/kicker/pipeline.json `brow` region and boss/pipeline.json `jaw` zone; run.py --asset kicker --check and --asset boss --check; the Kicker test finds no slot-6 faces in the brow box and fails on 3e7084e's GLB; the boss test measures ink in the mouth-corner boxes on the baked mask and fails on 3e7084e's mask. No numbers in scripts against the rules, the layer rules, no key printed or written, no paid spend. The merged suite is already run (below): don't rerun the whole suite; run single files with -gselect where you need them.

common_note: State: m6/full-art-audio at dc3ba85, PR #6 open and unmerged. Game-boy played M6 (663cafc) and asked for four fixes (the ground flashing, the GO sting, not feeling the hits he takes, blobby enemies). After a FEEDBACK round, a review, a fix wave, a verification round and its fix pass (3e7084e), an independent vfinal round found one medium (the hurt vignette's depth compounding on rear hits) and lows (docs/reviews/M6/findings-vfinal.json). A fix pass of three Sonnet fixers (VF2-FEEL, VF2-WORLD, VF2-ART; calls in docs/milestones/M6-calls/VF2-*.md) was merged at dc3ba85. This round checks that pass independently; its fixers' claims are claims. Suite on the merged head: 2076/2076 in 415 s with ART_PUNK_VARIANT_STRAIN=1, 0 SCRIPT/SHADER/ERROR lines. Every run.py --check (bruiser, boss, kicker, thug, punk, dummy), player_run.py --asset player --check, gen_palette.py --check and gen_trim.gd --check said YES. The lead's look at the fixers' sheets: the rear smash's spikes stop at about 30% of the height (53% before), the front smash unchanged; the Kicker's pale crescent under the brim is now brown shade; Ox's mouth-corner hook is gone. Fresh recordings on dc3ba85 are in captures_dir, one folder per act (bot.avi, bot.log, sheets/): r_kicker, r_thug, r_bruiser, r_boss, r_punk, dk, dox, lineup, damage, hurt (now with the rear run), passive_six, rooms (crowd bot); tour, drift (level bot on mission1.tscn). BEFORE (3e7084e): /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/captures/m6-verify-final/; d582d21: captures/m6-feedback-verify/; 82bab12 (the world's look bar): captures/m6-feedback-review/; the build Game-boy played (663cafc): captures/m6-played/ (r_kicker, r_thug, r_bruiser, r_boss, r_punk, lineup, tour). Cut finer stills with ffmpeg from bot.avi when you need a moment. Severity: high = Game-boy would see it in normal play and it undoes one of his four asks; medium = visible at 1-3 m or in a fight, or a rule or test that does not hold; low = everything else. Perf is the lead's: frame time at 3e7084e matched d582d21 (level walk 17.77 against 17.80 ms), with about 24 more draws a frame from the clipped blocks' own meshes; not a finding. Spec departures already ruled by Game-boy: the victim camera stack and the silent GO (README). Left by the lead, don't report: the ground's mirrored pair, the catwalk doorway's tan ground patch, the Bruiser's small stair under the visor and his visor slit taking blood, Ox's mauve shadow-band patches.
